verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a CLI and team-scoped API keys for managing resources. None of it mentions usage or billing endpoints, cost reports, or any way to break down GPU spend by team or workload. General resource-management API access is an adjacent building block, not the billing-attribution capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can pull usage and billing breakdowns programmatically to attribute GPU spend by team or workload
